// Opt-out fixture for surface/src/timing-lint.ts (read by surface/test/timing-lint.test.ts, never run): every timing
// finding here is covered by a well-formed opt-out whose fake clock is in use, so the check reports no finding and no
// problem, and counts 6 opted-out findings.
import { expect, test, vi } from "bun:test";

// timing-under-test: the lease lapses exactly at its expiry (fake clock: clock)
test("a whole test opted out", async () => {
	const clock = fakeClock(0);
	const lease = takeLease(clock, 30_000);
	clock.advance(30_000);
	await Bun.sleep(0);
	expect(Date.now() - lease.at).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(30_000);
});

test("one line opted out, trailing", () => {
	vi.useFakeTimers();
	setTimeout(fire, 1_000); // timing-under-test: the debounce fires after one second (fake clock: vi.useFakeTimers)
	vi.advanceTimersByTime(1_000);
});

test("one line opted out, from the line above", () => {
	vi.useFakeTimers();
	// timing-under-test: the poll interval is 25 ms (fake clock: vi.advanceTimersByTime)

	const poll = setInterval(check, 25);
	vi.advanceTimersByTime(25);
	expect(checks).toBe(1);
});

// timing-under-test: the stuck detector fires after persistMs of hot ticks (fake clock: tick)
describe("a whole describe opted out", () => {
	const tick = (ms: number) => now.value += ms;
	test("fires", () => {
		const end = Date.now() + 10;
		while (Date.now() < end) tick(1);
	});
});
